definitions.gloss: main hall of a Buddhist temple
definitions.explanation: The primary building of a Buddhist temple where the principal image of the Buddha is enshrined. It is the central structure for worship and ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {本堂|ほんどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I prayed at the main hall of the temple.

examples.japanese: {本堂|ほんどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The main hall is designated as a national treasure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修復|しゅうふく}→修復：11544_shuufuku⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧{本堂|ほんどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}した→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: The main hall, having completed restoration work, has regained its beautiful appearance.

notes:
USAGE:
{本堂|ほんどう} is used specifically for Buddhist temples. When visiting temples in Japan, it is the main building where visitors go to pray. Major temple main halls, such as those at {清水寺|きよみずでら} or {東大寺|とうだいじ}, are important cultural landmarks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本堂|ほんどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{参|まい}り→お参り：16837_omairi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pray at the main hall)
- {本堂|ほんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (in front of the main hall)
- {本堂|ほんどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修復|しゅうふく}→修復：11544_shuufuku⟧ (restoration of the main hall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Shinto shrines use ⟦{本殿|ほんでん}→本殿：13090_honden⟧ (main sanctuary) or ⟦{拝殿|はいでん}→拝殿：24252_haiden⟧ (worship hall) instead of {本堂|ほんどう}. {金堂|こんどう} is an alternative name for the main hall used in some older temple traditions.
